name: Knitting Row & Repeat Counter
description: Track rows, rounds, pattern repeats and confirmed stitch changes with independent parts and undo

document.title: Knitting progress
document.boundary: Plans are reminders, not completed work. Stitch changes are applied only when a row or round is confirmed.

help: Create a project with separate parts, choosing flat rows or circular rounds and initial stitches. Progress and the last selected part are saved locally in the host application database.

Add your own repeat segments. Appended segments begin after both the current progress and the last configured segment, so adding a new section never rewrites completed rows. Finishing all planned sections still allows deliberate free counting.

Reminders have a first row or round, a positive interval, a signed stitch change, and a number of occurrences. Select execute or skip for every reminder due on the next row. Choosing alone never changes stitches; confirming the row applies changes in rule-list order.

Undo restores the previous row count, repeat position, stitch count and pending reminder choices together. Stitch correction is also undoable. Copying a part preserves its rules and original row numbers but starts at zero progress and initial stitches.

Space completes one row or round only on the counter view. Holding the key does not repeat, and input fields, buttons and editors retain their normal keyboard behavior. A saved status is shown only after the database acknowledges the update.

Existing rules can be removed only before progress begins and with no undo entries; later additions must be in the future. Clearing or deleting requires confirmation. Clearing keeps the rules and notes but resets progress and its undo stack.

JSON backups preserve the whole workshop, including selections and undo. Restoring explicitly replaces the current workshop. Markdown is a readable summary; it is not a restorable backup. No commercial patterns or diagrams are included.

Limits: 50 projects, 20 parts per project, 20 pattern segments and 20 reminders per part; 100,000 rows or rounds and undo entries, 1,000,000 stitches, 10,000 rule repetitions; 8 MiB stored document and 32 MiB export. No automatic trimming is performed.

part.title: Parts
part.empty: Add an independent part to this project

counter.title: Knitting progress
counter.emptyHint: Create a project and a part, then add your own pattern repeats and stitch reminders.
counter.shortcut: Space to count · holding never repeats

segment.title: Pattern segments
segment.name: Segment {{index}}
segment.empty: No repeat segments; free counting is available.
segment.finished: All configured segments are finished. Continue freely or append a future segment.
segment.free: No pattern segment on this row or round. Advance only when you finish it.

reminder.title: Stitch reminders
reminder.name: Reminder {{index}}
reminder.forNext: Due on the next row or round ({{count}})
reminder.none: No stitch changes are due. Confirm only when this row or round is finished.
reminder.notActual: These choices are plans for this row. Stitches change only when you confirm completion, in rule-list order.
reminder.pending: Choose execute or skip for {{count}} remaining reminders.
reminder.invalidStitches: The selected changes would make stitches negative or exceed the limit. Skip a change or correct the count.
reminder.projected: After completion: {{value}} stitches. The current count has not changed yet.

rules.locked: Progress already exists. Append future rules, or copy the part / explicitly clear progress before removing existing rules.

formHints.project: Each part has its own counters and rules. Duplicate names do not share progress.
formHints.part: Start this part from zero completed rows or rounds.
formHints.copy: Copy rules and their row numbers, notes, and initial stitches. Progress and undo start empty.
formHints.segment: Choose rows per repeat and repeat count. The new segment is placed after existing segments and completed work.
formHints.reminder: Use a future first row, positive interval and repetition count. Positive changes add stitches; negative changes remove stitches.
formHints.details: Editing names or notes does not advance progress.
formHints.adjust: Confirm a measured correction. It does not advance a row and can be undone. Before the first row it also updates initial stitches.

confirm.part: Delete this part and its progress?
confirm.project: Delete this project and all its parts?
confirm.restore: Replace the workshop with this backup?
confirm.hint: This action changes saved data. Export a JSON backup first if you may need it later.
confirm.restoreHint: All current projects and progress will be replaced by the selected backup. Export the current workshop first if needed.

errors.knitting.name: Names are required, at most 80 characters, and cannot contain control characters.
errors.knitting.number: Enter a whole number within the allowed range. Rows, intervals and repetition counts must be positive.
errors.knitting.invalid_state: The saved document or backup is inconsistent. No changes were applied.
errors.knitting.limits: A project, part, note, rule or numeric limit was exceeded.
errors.knitting.segment: Invalid or overlapping pattern segment; repeat count and ending row must stay within the limits.
errors.knitting.reminder: Invalid stitch reminder: use a positive interval, 1–10,000 occurrences, a nonzero change, and an end no later than row 100,000.
errors.knitting.selection: The selected project, part or rule no longer exists.
errors.knitting.history_limit: The undo-step limit was reached. Export a backup before copying or clearing the part.
errors.knitting.state_limit: Stored workshop exceeds 8 MiB, or the input file exceeds the read limit. Export and explicitly remove unneeded data.
errors.knitting.export_limit: Export exceeds 32 MiB. Export a smaller workshop.
errors.knitting.past_rule: A new reminder must start after the last completed row or round.
errors.knitting.edit_locked: Existing rules can be removed only at zero progress with an empty undo stack. Copy or explicitly clear the part first.
errors.knitting.stale_line: Progress already changed. That completion was not repeated.
errors.knitting.row_limit: This part reached the 100,000-row or round limit.
errors.knitting.stitches: A confirmed stitch change would make the count negative or greater than 1,000,000.
errors.knitting.pending: Choose execute or skip for every due reminder before completing the row.
errors.knitting.no_undo: No progress step is available to undo.
errors.knitting.file: Could not read or save the selected file.
errors.knitting.format: Only JSON and Markdown exports are supported.
errors.knitting.stale_state: The workshop changed while this result was being prepared. Reload and try again.
